text: I can estimate pre-training compute with 6 × parameters × tokens and convert it to GPU-days using a stated peak FLOP/s and MFU.
I can explain the Chinchilla result (about 20 tokens per parameter) and why heavily served models are trained on far more tokens.
I can define MFU, distinguish it from HFU, and list where the missing utilisation goes in a large job.
I can derive job MTBF as per-component MTBF ÷ component count and walk through the detect, swap, restart timeline of a failure.
I can choose a checkpoint interval with √(2δM) and quantify the waste saved by asynchronous checkpointing.
I can contrast training and inference fleets on coupling, failure impact, network and the metric each is judged by.
